title: Answer
description:
Each older word in this chapter had a first speaker and first hearers. Those words are now what God says to the Son or about the Son.

They do not say that the Son is merely kinder than angels. Together they say who He is.

He is God’s final speech, the heir, the exact image, the One who purged sins, the One angels worship, the One addressed as God, the Creator who does not change, and the One seated until His enemies are under His feet. The older prophetic word had not yet said that plainly.
